project.name: Oneohtrix Point Never
project.notes:
ONEOHTRIX POINT NEVER  (Daniel Lopatin: Rifts, Eccojams, R Plus Seven, Garden of Delete, Age Of)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- The Juno-60 (his father's) is central: "I learned on it... just having this one thing";
  Eccojams: "I'll just fucking loop it... put some echo on it"; GoldWave early on (RBMA
  lecture).
- R Plus Seven: Ableton Live 9's audio-to-MIDI, text-to-speech scripts sliced into samplers,
  "the micro detail of MIDI"; he loves the Korg Wavestation and M1 (Electronic Beats).
- Omnisphere choirs on Garden of Delete and the Returnal gear list: unconfirmed.

THIS TEMPLATE
Juno Arp: OB-Xf "J60 PWM Pluck" through TAL-Chorus-LX (Juno-60 chorus model). Eccojam Loop:
Sampler with SP Tape Echo and Pro Wave Tune at -3 semitones (slowed feel; it follows one
pitch at a time). Stretch: an audio track with PaulXStretch for extreme time-stretching.
Choir (Surge XT), Granular (OB-Xf soundscape through Grain Strain "Strange Mix"), Vocal
Fragments pitched +5 with Pro Wave Tune.

MIX NOTES
- Space is the instrument: ValhallaSupermassive 100% wet on the Reverb return, long echo.
- Leave dynamics: master glue at 1.5:1, CHOWTapeModel "Warm Tape", Lemon Limiter +1.5 dB;
  -16 to -12 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Medium-good. No Juno-60 model as such (patches and the chorus stand in); no stereo imager on
the master.

SOURCES
RBMA lecture "Oneohtrix Point Never"; Electronic Beats "Simulacra & Simulation"; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TAL-Chorus-LX (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-chorus-lx
- PaulXStretch (GPL-3.0): https://sonosaurus.com/paulxstretch/
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- Grain Strain (freeware): https://fullbucket.de/music/grainstrain.html
- CHOWTapeModel (GPL-3.0): https://chowdsp.com/products.html
- ValhallaSupermassive (freeware): https://valhalladsp.com/valhallasupermassive/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 80 BPM, 4/4, key Dbmaj, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Juno Arp (Instrument, -8 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Plucks/J60 PWM Pluck"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Chorus-LX: default settings
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -10 dB
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -12 dB
- Eccojam Loop (slowed) (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Sampler (SP-303 model): effect TapeEcho on, CTRL 1-3 = 40%, 60%, 50%; quantize oFF; pad grade standard
    FX: Pro Wave Tune: pitch shift -3 st, formant +0 st, correction off
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -8 dB
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Stretch (PaulXStretch) (Audio, +0 dB) -> Music Bus
    FX: Sonosaurus: PaulXStretch: default settings
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Choir (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Pads/Synth Choir MW O-Ah"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB
- Granular (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Soundscapes/VHS Gallop"
    FX: Full Bucket Music: Grain Strain: factory preset "Strange Mix"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
- Vocal Fragments (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    FX: Pro Wave Tune: pitch shift +5 st, formant +3 st, correction off
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -10 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Perc Bus (bus 1): empty
- Music Bus (bus 2): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Warm Tape"
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): empty
- Reverb (bus 4): Valhalla DSP, LLC: ValhallaSupermassive: default settings; Mix 1.0, Feedback 0.75, Delay_Ms 0.5, Density 0.8, HighCut 1.0
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 1125, Feedback 0.6, Tone 4000, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Ratio 1.5, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Warm Tape"; Lemon Limiter: gain +1.5 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
